reuse.why: Extends the existing isMonthWideCategory predicate and the existing category queries rather than adding a parallel filter, though the template check is hand-written SQL instead of building on goal-template's getTemplates reader.

duplication.why: The template condition is one shared SQL fragment and one predicate, but setZero gets its own category query that nearly repeats getAverageCategories (only the join differs).

placement.why: The month-wide category rule stays in budget/actions.ts next to the predicate and queries that feed every month-wide action.

scope.why: Only the month-wide predicate, its feeding queries and corresponding tests change; single-category actions are untouched.

maintainability.why: The rule now reads in one predicate fed by one SQL fragment; the small cost is that each query must remember to select the fragment and setZero's query is another copy.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions (copyPreviousMonth, setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg) go through isMonthWideCategory.

disguised_duplication.where: setZero's new SELECT in actions.ts is an openly near-identical copy of getAverageCategories' query (LEFT vs INNER JOIN), not disguised.

one_place.where: isMonthWideCategory in budget/actions.ts plus the HAS_BUDGET_TEMPLATE_SQL fragment selected by every query that feeds it; the includeHidden option is removed so all actions apply the same rule.
